faction.name: Fire Country Smuggling Network
faction.goal: move illicit cargo and information around official controls
faction.current_plan: Rotate manifests and low-visibility routes while abandoning any route whose exposure cost exceeds its value.
faction.knowledge_policy: world truth and player knowledge remain separate
notes: Network survives through contacts, secrecy, routes, and bribery rather than a bespoke criminal mechanic.
goals: avoid concentration that lets authorities dismantle the network at once

plan_state.wake_policy: registered causal review or immediate causal trigger/information delivery

faction.scope: Unofficial Fire Country routes, forged documentation, illicit transport, and safe contacts
